decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Enchantress effects to draw cards and generate mana, while also utilizing combo pieces like Opalescence and Parallax Wave to control the board and create a powerful win condition. The deck aims to stall the opponent with cards like Solitary Confinement and Elephant Grass, while setting up a board state that allows for a quick finish with a large, enchantment-based army. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently ramp and draw cards through enchantments, while setting up a game-winning combo.

This deck revolves around utilizing enchantments to create a powerful combo that enables a win condition. By utilizing cards like Sterling Grove, Parallax Wave, and Replenish, the player can establish a strong board presence and overwhelm their opponent. The key strategy involves ramping up mana with cards like Serra's Sanctum and Wild Growth, while also drawing cards and controlling the board with enchantresses like Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence. With the ability to quickly establish a dominant position using enchantments, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent for a decisive victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Elf creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Armageddon. The deck also utilizes cards like Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures and maintain card advantage. The mana acceleration provided by cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle allows for explosive and efficient plays. Overall, the deck aims to establish a fast and powerful board presence to quickly defeat the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Replenish combo, which involves filling the graveyard with enchantments like Parallax Wave and Opalescence, then casting Replenish to bring them back into play. This allows the player to create a powerful board state and control the game. The deck includes cards like Abeyance and Decree of Silence to disrupt opponents' strategies, while also including cards like Frantic Search and Intuition for card draw and searching. Overall, the goal is to set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a strong enchantment presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing creature cards to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Hermit Druid and Survival of the Fittest are key to the strategy, allowing the player to search for and play important creatures like Triskelion and Akroma, Angel of Wrath. The deck also includes cards like Animate Dead and Psychatog to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up its own board presence. The combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells creates a versatile and potent deck that can win games through multiple avenues.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and land denial. By using cards like Swords to Plowshares, Mana Leak, and Counterspell, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Standstill and Fact or Fiction allows the player to draw cards while maintaining control of the board. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Dust Bowl and Powder Keg to further limit the opponent's resources. The win condition typically involves using Mishra's Factory and other creatures to chip away at the opponent's life total.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand, board, and resources through targeted discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, along with efficient removal like Diabolic Edict and Smother. The deck also aims to apply pressure with early creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Ravenous Rats, while utilizing The Rack to steadily chip away at the opponent's life total. With a mix of disruption, removal, and threats, this deck aims to control the game and grind out a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently put pressure on the opponent with cheap, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By using cards like Mogg Fanatic, Grim Lavamancer, and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently, while also utilizing cards like Black Vise and Pyrostatic Pillar to punish opponents for holding too many cards or casting spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent and reduce their life total to zero before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using enchantments to create a powerful board presence and generate value. The key strategy involves ramping up mana with enchantments like Wild Growth and Serra's Sanctum, while drawing cards with Enchantress's Presence and Mirri's Guile. The combo finish involves playing Opalescence to turn all enchantments into creatures, using Parallax Wave and Replenish to control the board and bring back key cards from the graveyard. Protection and control are provided by cards like Swords to Plowshares, Solitary Confinement, and Sterling Grove.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies through card advantage and countermagic while utilizing the powerful creature Psychatog as a win condition. The deck includes a variety of control spells such as Counterspell and Smother, along with card draw spells like Gush and Accumulated Knowledge. By efficiently controlling the board and drawing cards, the deck aims to set up a strong Psychatog to close out the game. Additionally, disruptive spells like Duress and Annul help to further hinder opponents' game plans.

This deck focuses on using enchantments to control the game and build up a powerful board state. The key strategy revolves around using enchantress effects like Enchantress's Presence and Argothian Enchantress to draw cards and generate mana. Opalescence and Parallax Wave provide removal and win conditions, while Replenish allows for explosive plays by returning multiple enchantments from the graveyard. Serra's Sanctum acts as a mana engine, enabling the deck to cast multiple spells in a turn. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of synergy and resilience.

The primary strategy of this deck revolves around quickly getting out Phyrexian Dreadnought and using cards like Stifle to prevent opponents from countering or removing it. With a focus on counter spells and card draw, the deck aims to assemble the combo efficiently while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Opt, Gush, and Vision Charm, the deck aims to dig deep into the library to find the necessary pieces to win the game. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with the powerful combo and counter any threats that may arise.

The deck focuses on efficiently controlling the opponent's actions while gradually building up the power of its own creatures. It utilizes cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt to filter through the deck and find key cards, along with Counterspell and Meddling Mage to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Quirion Dryad and Psychatog are used as win conditions, with Gemstone Mine and City of Brass providing the necessary mana. The deck also includes some removal and disruptive elements to further control the game and ensure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the board by using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Winter's Grasp while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The key strategy revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore and Sphere of Resistance early in the game. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through Sylvan Library and to ramp up mana with Mox Diamond and Thermokarst. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through overwhelming board presence and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out Phyrexian Dreadnought while using cards like Stifle, Foil, and Counterspell to protect the combo. It also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Opt, Portent, and Gush. The goal is to efficiently control the game until you can drop the Dreadnought and win the game in one massive turn. It utilizes a combination of countermagic, card advantage, and tempo plays to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory with the combo.

The main focus of this premodern 1 vs 1 Combo-Stiflenought deck is to quickly get out Phyrexian Dreadnought, which combines with Stifle to create a powerful threat. The deck also includes various counterspells and card draw spells to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. The use of disruptive cards like Chain of Vapor and Misdirection adds versatility and control to the deck, while cards like Portent and Vision Charm can help set up the combo or disrupt the opponent's plans.
